{{Quote|And may I present Kaddit.|Zilaash Kuh, introducing Kaddit to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
'''Kaddit''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who worked for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] around [[43 ABY]]. He assisted [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces in the initial arrest of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and was later partnered with fellow hunter [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]] to capture the rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], who was suffering from a [[Force psychosis|psychotic breakdown]]. Kaddit opened fire with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on the [[Galaxy 9 News|news]] [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] in which Horn was riding and disabled the vehicle, but the fugitive Jedi was quickly detained by Skywalker.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Chief of State has ordered us to take the rogue Jedi into custody.|Zilaash Kuh, to Luke Skywalker, on her assignment with Kaddit|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
[[File:GA_Roundel.svg|thumb|right|230px|Kaddit often worked for the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances (pictured).]]
Kaddit was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who often worked for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="Outcast" /> In [[43 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'' to [[43 ABY]].</ref> he was hired to assist [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Savar]] during the initial arrest of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Skywalker was taken to the [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]]; however, he was released soon after.<ref name="Outcast" />

Kaddit was later partnered with fellow bounty hunter [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]] as a member of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Daala's special-missions force|special-missions force]] to capture the fugitive [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], who had gone on a destructive rampage through the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after suffering a [[Force psychosis|psychological breakdown]]. During the chase, Kuh and Kaddit flew a black, two-seater racing [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] with [[Engine/Legends|engines]] similar to those of a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]]. When they caught up to Horn&mdash;who, by that time had made a deal with a [[Galaxy 9 News]] reporter to exchange information in turn for transport in her speeder&mdash;Kaddit opened fire on Horn's vehicle with his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. The news speeder was damaged, but before they were able to capture Horn, Skywalker caught up to the Jedi and quickly incapacitated him. Kuh and Kaddit attempted to convince Skywalker to hand the fugitive over to Galactic Alliance custody on Daala's orders, but the Grand Master ignored them, and Horn was placed in the [[Mon Mothma Memorial Medical Center]].<ref name="Outcast" />

==Personality and traits==
Kaddit was often employed by the dominant galactic government of his time, the Galactic Alliance, and was known to work with other bounty hunters on assignments. When working with another hunter, Kaddit was rather passive, preferring to stand by and let his partner take command of the situation. During the hunt for Horn, Kuh piloted their black racing speeder&mdash;an airspeeder with arrow-tipped white stripes and engines reminiscent of a podracer's&mdash;while Kaddit fired on their quarry.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Equipment==
The Rodian was a skilled [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]]; he carried an unusually long [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifle, complete with a [[Scope/Legends|scope]].<ref name="Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaddit appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', the first novel in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series that was written by [[Aaron Allston]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="Outcast" />
